answer: Dilute the attacker own yield instead of taxing admission only. Every epoch the protocol meters active identities; when growth exceeds 5 percent, all emission is scaled by one minus the growth excess, so a farm minting clones immediately cuts the payout of every clone it adds. New identities earn nothing for their first 6 epochs while still paying the 30 POA bond, and their forfeited share accrues to a grove of long-tenured holders. A glacier of forged accounts grows the denominator faster than the numerator, so the ember of marginal profit dies before the bonds amortise.
